purpose.summary: This is a batch COBOL program (ORCR0486) that is part of the ORCA Japanese Medical Association standard receipt (claims) software. It generates monthly insurance claim detail files for self-pay (Jikofutan/Jikohoken) receipts, handling data editing, printing, and file creation for health insurance billing. It reads indexed patient/insurance files (RECE41, RECE43, RECE47), formats receipt data including disease names, comments, and point totals, and writes output for printing.

verdict.notes: The file is genuine production COBOL from the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system (Japan). Japanese comments are encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is large (3811 lines, ~166KB) with a detailed multi-year revision history, confirming production maturity. No embedded SQL or CICS; all I/O is via indexed sequential files. The COPY statements reference external copybooks not shown here.
